appDescription.message: Local-first manga and manhwa translation with a companion engine.

farDeferred.message: Far images are deferred until they approach the viewport.

engineConnectedBlocked.message: Engine connected, but the selected profile is not ready

enginePermissionMissing.message: Local engine access is not enabled

privacyLocal.message: Images are processed by the Local Engine on this device.

privacyRemoteText.message: Extracted text may leave this device only if the selected Engine profile reports that behavior.

privacyNoTelemetry.message: No external telemetry is enabled by default.

profileGateBlocked.message: Production profile is not ready. Complete the benchmark/model freeze before translating with default-v1.

permissionBody.message: Grant only this exact image origin, or use the visible screenshot fallback.

errorEnginePermissionBody.message: Enable access only to 127.0.0.1 in Engine Setup.

errorEngineOfflineBody.message: No page data was lost. Start the companion engine and recheck the connection.

errorPairingBody.message: Open Engine Setup and pair this extension with the local companion.

errorProfileBody.message: The engine reports that models, hardware, provider, or renderer setup is incomplete.

errorImagePermissionBody.message: This image is served from another HTTPS origin. Grant only that origin or use visible capture.

errorCaptureVisibleBody.message: Scroll the image into view, then retry the visible capture.

errorUnsupportedImageBody.message: This raster format or response cannot be processed safely.

errorStaleBody.message: The old result was discarded because the page or image changed.

errorInternalBody.message: The operation stopped safely. Copy diagnostics if the problem repeats.

errorGenericBody.message: Review the details and retry after correcting the blocker.

diagnosticsPrivacy.message: Diagnostics exclude page URLs, manga titles, OCR text, translations, API keys, pairing tokens, and filesystem paths.

keyboardHelp.message: The suggested shortcut is Alt+Shift+M. Change it from chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

productionGateBlocked.message: default-v1 remains blocked until benchmark winners and model hashes are frozen.

probeFailed.message: The probe failed. The engine may be stopped or Local Network Access may still be blocked.

lnaDenied.message: Chrome Local Network Access is denied for this extension.

notActivatedHelp.message: Open a manga page and activate the extension from the toolbar or shortcut.

providerManaged.message: Provider credentials and network behavior are owned by the selected Local Engine profile. The extension does not store provider API keys.

privacyImageMayLeave.message: The selected Engine profile reports that image data may leave this device.

privacyTextMayLeave.message: The selected Engine profile reports that extracted OCR text may leave this device.

privacyTextUnknown.message: The selected Engine profile does not declare whether extracted OCR text can leave this device.

privacyVisualMayLeave.message: The selected Engine profile reports that visual context may leave this device.

modelCatalogEmpty.message: No production model downloads are published yet. Freeze Gate D with verified model artifacts before publishing this catalog.

privacyDisclosurePending.message: Privacy disclosure required before page access

privacyDisclosureTitle.message: Before Manga Translator reads this page

privacyDisclosureBody.message: When you activate translation, the extension reads comic images and the current-page origin so it can detect, process, and replace translated images.

privacyDisclosureData.message: Data handled locally can include the current-page origin, image bytes or screenshot crops, OCR text, translated text, and generated result/cache data.

privacyDisclosureLocalOnly.message: This consent covers processing between Chrome and the Local Engine on this computer. It does not authorize sending image or text data to an external provider.

privacyDisclosureRetention.message: Local result cache can be cleared in Settings. Completed Local Engine job files are automatically cleaned after at most 24 hours.

privacyDisclosureNoAds.message: The extension does not use this data for advertising, profiling, or unrelated analytics. External telemetry is disabled by default.

privacyConsentButton.message: I agree — activate on this page

remotePrivacyDisclosurePending.message: Separate consent is required for external text translation

remotePrivacyDisclosureTitle.message: Before extracted text leaves this device

remotePrivacyDisclosureBody.message: The selected profile sends extracted dialogue and narration text to $1 over HTTPS so it can be translated into Arabic.

remotePrivacyDisclosureData.message: Only OCR text classified locally as dialogue or narration is eligible for this external translation request.

remotePrivacyDisclosureLocalImages.message: Comic images, screenshot pixels, masks, and visual context remain on this device.

remotePrivacyDisclosureSfx.message: Sound effects and uncertain text are filtered locally and are not sent to the translation provider.

remotePrivacyDisclosureBinding.message: This consent is bound to this exact profile fingerprint, provider list, privacy descriptor, and disclosure version; a change requires consent again.
